data.one_liner: Foundation plugin providing camera access, context, and data capture views for Scandit SDK packages.
data.what_it_does: It serves as the core foundational plugin for all data capture functionality offered by the Scandit Data Capture SDK. It provides the data capture context, camera handling, and data capture view that other Scandit packages require to function.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Scandit SDK modules like barcode capture or ID capture
You need the core data capture context and camera view provided by Scandit
avoid_when: You are looking for a standalone, non-Scandit QR or barcode scanning solution
Your project targets Android versions below minSdk 24 or iOS versions below 15.0
strengths: Provides robust foundational infrastructure for all Scandit data capture modules
Manages data capture context and camera view lifecycles
weaknesses: Requires specific platform versions (Android minSdk 24, iOS 15.0)
Cannot be used as a standalone scanner without other Scandit packages
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.22.0+, Android minSdk 24+, Android Gradle Plugin 8.1.4, Kotlin 1.8.22, Gradle 8.2+, Java 17, and iOS 15.0+.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose, non-commercial barcode and QR scanner plugin instead of the proprietary Scandit SDK ecosystem.
